name: vani
description: VANI — Visualizing Academic Networks and Ideas

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @vani/api" "npm run dev -w @vani/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run build -w @vani/api && npm run build -w @vani/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @vani/shared && npm run test -w @vani/api && npm run test -w @vani/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vani/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vani/api && npm run typecheck -w @vani/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
